test: Test 10: full demo runs of TCAFF with confidence-weighted on-board cluster candidates (variant A of test 9)
method: src/demo_cpu/demo.py on the authors' saved detections with the released parameters, as the B0 runs of check 4, with cluster_patch.py applied in the running process (vendor code unchanged). Each run is verified by the repository's scripts/segment_unit/evaluate_run.py (temporal-filter replay must reproduce the run; GT recomposed independently). 5 repeats.

variant.clusters: built at every frame-alignment update from each robot's own map: candidates w <= 0.5, 0.08 <= h <= 0.6, |z - z_robot| <= 0.35 (z_robot from that robot's odometry at its latest mapping time), single linkage 0.7 m, 2..10 members, radius <= 1.0 m
variant.use: all cluster pairs appended to the size-gated object candidates; affinity M' = D M D with q_u = sqrt(q_K q_L) for cluster pairs, sigma_G 0.30, epsilon_G 0.50 for edges with a cluster node; object-object entries as released (one-to-one rule kept); cluster pseudo-object age 2 x youngest member age / sqrt(q_K)

reference: B0: the 5 full runs of check 4 (results/segment_unit/unit_test/runs/B0): Acc 76.69%, range 0.47 pp, wrong first decisions 10 of 60
decision_rule: as checks 6-7 and test 5: improves on B0 if mean Acc exceeds B0's by more than B0's range over repeats AND wrong first decisions do not exceed B0's (10 of 60); accepted wrong modes (> 2 m or > 15 deg) reported alongside; the replay-based test 9 predicted Acc 78.9%
status: exploratory; one recording; ramp ends informed by this recording
